## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Clear enough that “future you” can run it
- [ ] Fits in 1–2 pages (or one screen per section)
- [ ] Contains meaningful player choice
- [ ] Contains at least one hook and one consequence

<Aside type="tip">
  If it feels too big, reduce scope. A small runnable project beats a grand
  unfinished one.
</Aside>

## Deliverable

Publish/share one artifact:

- Markdown file, Google Doc, Notion page, or Gist

- Add 2–5 bullets: what you tried, what you’d improve, what you’re proud of
